ShortDescription.Value: Adds Light Industrial Zoning and Heavy Industrial Zoning, separating low-impact consumer-oriented industry from high-pollution factories that produce raw materials.

Publish.LongDescription:
**This mod is a work in progress**
Introducing two zoning types: **Light Industrial Zoning** and **Heavy Industrial Zoning**
Light Industry produces less noise and pollution, allowing industrial areas to coexist much easier with residential areas. Light industry will also visually appear less pollutive, such that they do not spawn with chimneys or smoke/steam effects. This is much more realistic, as most industry in real life is done in unassuming warehouse-looking buildings without giant smokestacks.
### Current values - Ground Pollution: 5/100 (1/3) - Air Pollution: 0/100 (0/3) - Noise Pollution: 30/100 (1/3)
### Related mods / design philosophy I am aware of: - "Clean Industry Zones" by Mimonsi - "Specialized Industry Zones" by DillN2
This mod aims to feel as vanilla as possible, be future-proof for new assets, and be safe to remove from saves. It avoids relying on a separate asset pack by modifying vanilla industry prefabs at runtime.
### What is done so far - Pollution levels set to the values above - Assets spawn without chimneys/smokestacks and smoke/steam VFX - Fixed chimneys reappearing after a while - Added a Heavy Industry zoning type (currently behaves like vanilla) - Added a settings dropdown for blacklisting or whitelisting industrial assets - Fixed the UI zoning image
### Problems / to-do - Add a downside (eg reduced profitability) so Light Industry is balanced - Split goods production (Light: complex goods; Heavy: raw materials)
